_metadata.notice: ESTIMATE ONLY - Common companion animal health risks and breed predispositions for verification.

health_conditions.name: Brachycephalic Obstructive Airway Syndrome (BOAS)
health_conditions.description: Upper airway abnormalities in flat-faced breeds causing breathing distress, exercise intolerance, and severe heat vulnerability.

health_conditions.name: Canine Hip Dysplasia (CHD)
health_conditions.description: Malformation of the hip ball-and-socket joint leading to arthritis and pain, common in heavy, fast-growing breeds.

health_conditions.name: Tropical Heatstroke Vulnerability
health_conditions.description: Elevated sensitivity to core body temperature elevation above 41°C during hot, humid Indian weather.

health_conditions.name: Canine Tick-Borne Fever (Ehrlichia / Babesia)
health_conditions.description: Tick-transmitted hemoparasitic infections causing acute thrombocytopenia, high fever, and lethargy.

health_conditions.name: Progressive Retinal Atrophy (PRA)
health_conditions.description: Bilateral degeneration of the retina leading to progressive vision impairment and night blindness.

health_conditions.name: Feline Lower Urinary Tract Disease (FLUTD)
health_conditions.description: Urethral obstruction and bladder inflammation prevalent in indoor cats with low hydration.
